detailed_description: CSS Gradient Text creates a live preview and CSS snippet for linear gradient text. Enter the text to preview, choose two required colors and an optional third color, adjust the gradient angle, font size, and font weight, or apply one of the built-in presets such as Sunset, Ocean, Purple, Fire, Mint, or Night. The generated CSS uses a `linear-gradient`, background clipping, transparent text fill, and the selected font settings, then can be copied from the page.
usage_steps: Enter the text you want to preview.
Pick the first and second gradient colors, and optionally set a third color.
Adjust the angle slider to change the linear gradient direction.
Set the preview font size and font weight.
Optionally apply one of the built-in color presets.
Review the preview and copy the generated CSS snippet.
usage_examples: Create a linear gradient headline style for a landing page mockup.
Try the Ocean or Purple preset before copying CSS for a portfolio heading.
Adjust font weight and size to test how a gradient title reads at different scales.
Use three colors to draft a simple brand-style text effect.
